Mina: Quick sync 1: enterprise requests for 'forensic' cost + error analytics tied to model rollouts. Need scope options for next sprint.
Ravi: Customer asks = per-model cost delta, sample traces for disputed requests, and CSV export for finance.
Clara: Engineering notes: we can: (A) add model_variant tag at request boundary and aggregate metrics; (B) propagate hashed_tenant + model_variant into runtime for sampled token-level traces; (C) full-token attribution end-to-end (high risk).
Jules: Propose three packages: Audit (A), Forensics (B), Full-Trace (C). Audit = low effort, Forensics = medium (sampling + UI drill), Full-Trace = large (runtime changes + bench).
Mina: Acceptance criteria - Audit: dashboard delta + drill to filtered traces (no token mapping). Forensics: sampled token spans for selected tenants + CSV export. Full-Trace: exact mapping, regression alerts, canary.
Ravi: Perf caution: adding token spans naively increases tail latency. Suggest sampling 2% by default and toggle per-tenant.
Clara: Pseudocode for hashed tenant attach:
```
span.set_attr('hashed_tenant', h(tenant_id))
span.set_attr('model_variant', model)
```
ops-bot: perf job queued perf-9001 ETA 36h.
Mina: Ok we'll present options and cost/impact at Fri prioritization. Jules please own decision doc, Ravi to scope perf impact.
Jules: Will do, sharing draft link later. :thumbsup:
